headline_gaps: bf16: we pay +0.031 (qwen, 0.671 vs 0.64) to +0.057 (worst-model) vs UCCL-Zip's GPU ANS, and +0.14-0.17 vs TRACE's custom silicon — that premium buys zero new hardware and zero receiver GPU/SM cost.
fp8_e5m2 on the modern model: 0.704 vs UCCL-Zip's 0.70 — ANS PARITY through a commodity-decodable deflate stream.
SplitZip v3 (custom GPU codec) is WORSE than our BF3-decodable path on ratio: bf16 0.755 vs our 0.697-0.671; e5m2 0.877 vs our 0.724-0.704. It wins only on throughput.
DFloat11's 0.70 is on weights; our 0.671-0.697 on KV shows KV channel structure is at least as exploitable.
